$PaO_2/FiO_2$ ratio measured at day 3. The ratio of arterial oxygen partial pressure (PaO2 in mmHg) to fractional inspired oxygen (FiO2 expressed as a fraction). Level of functional disability of the patient in a 1-5 scale, with 5 being the highest severity. Listed values are: {1: "no(Month 2 and SIP pres)", "adl>=4 (>=5 if sur)", "SIP>=30", "Coma or Intub", 5: "<2 mo. follow-up"}.
